title: Payment Plan Limits by Floor Plan (Apartment Home Lease)
content:
A payment plan on an Apartment Home Lease is shaped by six floor plan values: the most installments after the down payment, the minimum down payment as a share of the arrears covered, the largest arrears a plan may cover as a multiple of monthly rent, the number of plans that may be signed within the trailing 365 days, the calendar days between installments, and the calendar days after an installment's due date before the plan is treated as defaulted.

| Floor plan | Maximum installments after the down payment | Minimum down payment (share of arrears) | Maximum arrears (multiple of monthly rent) | Plans that may be signed in the trailing 365 days | Days between installments | Days of grace after a missed installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 2 | 0.5 (50%) | 2.00 | 1 | 14 | 3 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 2 | 0.5 (50%) | 2.00 | 1 | 14 | 3 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 3 | 0.4 (40%) | 2.00 | 1 | 14 | 3 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 3 | 0.4 (40%) | 2.00 | 1 | 14 | 3 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 3 | 0.4 (40%) | 2.00 | 2 | 14 | 3 |
| Penthouse Residence | 4 | 0.33 (33%) | 2.00 | 2 | 14 | 3 |

## Reading the limits

- **Maximum installments** — an integer count of installments that follow the down payment.
- **Minimum down payment** — a decimal fraction of the arrears covered.
- **Maximum arrears** — a decimal multiple of the monthly rent; 2.00 on every floor plan, so a plan may cover at most two months of rent.
- **Plans per trailing 365 days** — 1 on the four smaller floor plans, 2 on the Three-Bedroom and Penthouse Residences.
- **Installment interval** — 14 calendar days on every floor plan.
- **Missed-installment grace** — 3 calendar days on every floor plan.

*Hypothetical:* with an example monthly rent of $2,400.00, the maximum arrears multiple of 2.00 corresponds to $4,800.00 of arrears on any floor plan. The rent is an example input.
